items.scope: Native Codex and TypeScript-Go embedded dependencies
items.action: Per-platform findings are recorded for macOS, Linux and Windows x64 (third_party/evidence/native-ai-platform-packages.json, from the published npm tarballs, not run on those platforms). TypeScript native 7.0.2: NOTICE.txt and LICENSE are in every platform package and byte-identical. Codex 0.162.1: every platform package also ships an optional voice runtime (LGPL-2.1 GStreamer/GLib, Opus, libffi, PCRE2, and Microsoft vcruntime140.dll on Windows) that FDO does not use; it is excluded from the app by webpack.main.config.js and enforced by third_party/distribution-policy.json (codex-voice-runtime), and the Codex CLI was confirmed to run without it. Linux ships a bubblewrap helper (LGPL-2.0-or-later) whose vendored source is added to the Linux native-source archive (openai/codex at commit 092d3acd). Still open: Codex helper binaries (rg, zsh, Windows sandbox executables) and Rust crates rely on the upstream NOTICE and the source-lock inventory; no complete native SBOM exists. After the final release commit, review the packaged builds, then record the reviewer, date and per-target input hashes. On 2026-11-20 the maintainer chose to retain bundled Codex and hold publication until its redistribution evidence is complete. The pinned supplier ripgrep manifest identifies 15.2.0. The production workflow pins codex-zsh-v0.1.0 manifest c534eab89dcea7e3d8a5e5b3f49c025c7c64cd4e4d9814ee24871de58a9359a1. Linux zsh and Linux/Windows ripgrep match the supplier executables exactly. Both macOS architectures match after removing signatures on comparison copies and normalizing the __LINKEDIT virtual-size field. The alpha manifest comparison did not represent production. The candidate adds the upstream zsh and ripgrep notices. Review their inclusion and the remaining embedded dependencies before clearance. The four e7612c0 legal archives contain the pinned helper notice bytes. The 2026-11-23 review verified five upstream Cargo timing artifacts and 980 registry archives against checksums. The four primary reports and Windows helper report cover 1,144 distinct compiled package/version pairs, including build tools and binaries outside FDO. Reconcile shipped binaries with embedded libraries and their notices, including V8 150.4.0 build inputs and MPL-2.0 components such as Symphonia. The maintainer has no additional supplier record. Keep this item pending until target-specific notice and source delivery are substantiated.
